provenance.coverage: Deterministic required-facts and constraint checklist over a structured briefing (21 rows): AC coverage and deferral, owner-decision status, level/environment per the provided rules, test-file naming, Touch recall/precision against named paths, closed-vocabulary scope classification, routing.
provenance.derivation: Inputs are exact baseline-commit bytes from the private civic app (spec and plan merged in PR #180): the merged free-form-actions plan (complete), spec sections 1-4, 7 and 8 and the owner-decision table (sections 5, 6, 9, 10 omitted and marked), a filtered file tree, verbatim excerpts of the eight existing test files the plan names, CI/runner/screen-name facts (database URL redacted) and the repo's own delegation-rubric, test-ladder, test-environment and briefing-packet skills. The reference is the real Phase 1 change (PR #192, 33 files) transcribed into the briefing shape: its AC set (FF1-FF9 plus FF9a, which the plan's test table omits), the tests it used, its touched files as Touch, the exclusions it kept (no eighth authenticity category, prompt untouched, Surface B later) and the unratified D2 mechanic it flagged. Checks are invariants, not wording: exact AC/deferred sets, the closed level/environment taxonomy with levels fixed only where the named test's shape determines them, set-based glob coverage of files the plan/spec say change and non-coverage of files they say stay unchanged, an exact out-of-scope set over a closed 17-item vocabulary, and the routing rule. Sanitized: Excerpts of private planning documents and test files; no secrets, hostnames, personal names or user data (the CI database URL is redacted; test fixture identities are placeholder values).
provenance.limitations: No model trial, representative-day coverage, native isolation, or contamination-free claim.
